title: Pamela Anderson Will Be Holding A Press Conference On Monday March 12th At The Mandalay Bay Resort & Casino
htmlContent: Activist and Humanitarian Pamela Anderson to hold a press conference at The Mandalay Bay Resort & Casino on Monday, March 12th. After issuing a statement, Pamela will answer select questions from the press.   Pamela will be discussing her recent ride-hailing campaigns, in addition to various other topics. The speech and press conference will occur during the LCT International Show.   Details: Mandalay Bay Resort & Casino – South Pacific F Monday, March 12th Pamela Anderson Keynote: 4:15 PM PDT Pamela Anderson Press Conference: 4:30 PM PDT SOURCE Pamela Anderson
